headline: Brink, Maasdam join Lawrence for unity event after splitting moderate vote
summary: In Michigan's 7th Congressional District, Democratic nominee William Lawrence won a primary with 43.7% of votes after former U.S. Ambassador Bridget Brink and former Navy SEAL Matt Maasdam split moderate votes nearly evenly at 28.8% and 27.6%. Lawrence united supporters at a rally with Brink and Maasdam, aiming to "flip the district" and elect a Democratic House speaker. Lawrence accepted their support but pledged not to accept corporate PAC money and vowed to listen to voters despite differing views on policy matters.

headline: Rep. Ed Case Holds Onto His Congressional Seat In A Landslide In Early Results
summary: In the Hawaii Democratic primary for lieutenant governor, incumbent Josh Green led state Sen. Jarrett Keohokalole as polls closed on Saturday night.

headline: Trinity Health CT hospitals cited for patient safety more than others
summary: Two Connecticut hospitals owned by Trinity Health of New England received multiple "immediate jeopardy" citations from CMS since 2023 due to serious patient safety issues, including staffing shortages and inadequate monitoring of high-risk patients. The state's comptroller and governor have expressed concerns about the quality of care and have been working with Trinity leadership to monitor improvements at Saint Francis Hospital in Hartford, which has received significant investments from the parent organization.

headline: Clap during a city meeting in Emporia and you too might be hustled off to jail. Just ask Lux.
summary: In Emporia, Kansas, public opposition to a proposed data center led to protests and civil unrest. A physics teacher, Lux Claridge, was arrested for clapping during a city commission meeting, sparking national attention. This incident, along with other concerns such as environmental pollution and loss of agency, has united traditionally differing factions in opposing the project. Despite heavy public opposition, city officials have continued to support the data center proposal, leading to further tensions between residents and local government.

headline: ‘I hear you, I see you:’ Alabama Democrats elect Bobby Singleton as chair
summary: Senate Minority Leader Bobby Singleton defeats incumbent Randy Kelley to become Alabama Democratic Party Chair. Singleton vows to listen to all members and increase diversity within party ranks.
